name: shop-serve~p1
task: Each time a client arrives, take their order, get food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove and hand it over; should the food fall, your very next move must pick it up.
error: critic-context-exceeded: the machine is too complex to review, its critic request is larger than the model's context window

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires each client to be handled by taking the order, getting food from the pantry, preparing it and handing it over. The candidate clauses enforce client_arrived -> order_taken, order_taken -> food_prepared and food_prepared -> order_served, but no clause ever requires food to be obtained after the order is taken. The environment makes food_prepared need holding_food at the previous step, so food must be in hand, yet the clauses do not state that the agent must fetch/hold food after order_taken, nor do they link obtaining food to the pantry step the task names. Add a requirement that after an order is taken the agent holds food before it is prepared, e.g. a Response(order_taken, holding_food) with the appropriate ordering to food_prepared, and keep the existing chain for the fall recovery. The ChainResponse food_fell -> holding_food is the intended recovery rule.
